rows.label: Hold follows its winning wave (the brief's example): A and its 16-HP front at 0, B's 2-HP front at A's +1, which dies on tick 0
Hold follows its winning wave from behind (A and its 16-HP front at -1, B's 2-HP front at 0)
Safe follows its winning wave (A and its 16-HP front at -2, B's 2-HP front at A's -1)
Yield (stand-off) in the same lane: it stays one cell behind B's starting front
Deliberate advance: A at 0 (its front at -1) Pressures through B's front at A's +1, which waits while A's crashed mass is under B's tower
The brief's B with walking waves: A at 0 (its front at -1) Trades toward B at its tower while B's front walks from A's +1 to 0: they swap cells within tick 0 (no shared cell at a tick boundary)
Trade chase into B's 16-HP wave (B stands behind it), connected, missed
The same chase, landed: positional aggro, then retaliation
Trade chase into B's wave; B evades out of contact (the Trade does not connect)
A Holds at B's tower cell far ahead of its wave and walks back: in B's oncoming front's cell after tick 0, covered by its own wave at the lane cell after tick 1
Cover on the same tick: A stands at 0 and both fronts walk into its cell on tick 0
No cover: as D2 with A's front far behind (at -3); B's front walks into A's cell on tick 0
Ward from +1 walks through B's front at the lane cell (A's front at -1)
Standing still in B's wave ahead of the own front (unchanged by the correction)
Adjacent to B's waiting front, never in its cell
B dives A's Recall through A's 16-HP front at A's -1 and lands: positional aggro on tick 0, retaliation from the end cell on tick 1
